title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Silent Ashes Remember Everything 🐦‍🔥 ~ Extend Ash ~ Person of Hourai (15K SUB SPECIAL Remix)
description:
❝ We should partner up next time.
Our ultimate firepower would fry any of our half-assed opponents! ❞
ㅤ- Fujiwara no Mokou, Touhou 15 Hyouibana ~ The Antinomy of Common Flowers (2017)



Did a special arrangement of Extend Ash ~ Person of Hourai / Hourai Victim from Touhou 8 Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night for my 15K SUBSCRIBER MILESTONE!!!. Similar to my 4k & 10k sub special remixes, I held another "Touhou X Mega Man" tournament to decide on the next remix, and Fujiwara No Mokou's stage theme won and burned the other competitors.

Always enjoyed Mokou's / Ex-Keine's stage theme. It has anice somberness to it while also being a great fast-paced track fitting for night-time ground stages. Though, I really wanted to go for a more slower-paced upbeat rendition for this one because that's just my vibe
(and also include a portion of her boss theme as well)
.
